# Patched MapLibre GL JS 5.6.0

Generated by `../scripts/patch-maplibre-terrain-clip.mjs` from the official unminified `maplibre-gl-dev.js`, then minified (`esbuild --minify`).

Adds terrain clip uniforms, fragment discard, and `getRenderableTiles` filtering for independent isolate islands. Do not edit by hand — re-run the patch script, then minify `maplibre-gl.js` again.
